Changes640
data.value:
The module update is complete! Thank you all for your feedback and support!
What’s new: • Added a toggle to enable or disable random names • Added map rotation so you can adjust the map angle • Added a toggle for abstract metro diagrams, off by default. Metro lines follow the game’s original track layout; turn it on to redraw routes • Fixed various errors caused by redundant DLLs
Please keep sharing your feedback!
